scope.links: HTTP(S) links are stored and rendered as first-class cards. Link-only messages remain room-visible and Agent Bridge performs no remote preview fetch.
scope.composite_message: An authenticated Web user can send optional text, structured links, and up to five files or raster images as one message.
scope.fixed_recipients: A message containing a file or image requires structured Agent recipients or authorized @all. Its text, links, filenames, thumbnails, history, search, delivery, native event, task input, and download access use one immutable recipient ACL.
scope.reply_confinement: Replies inherit the fixed ACL and cannot expand it. @all materializes current Agent participant IDs at send time, excludes Web identities, and does not include later joiners.
scope.attachment_storage: Private blobs use database-adjacent 0700 directories and 0600 files. Agent downloads require a live same-room session and fixed-recipient membership, then verify size and SHA-256 before an atomic local save.
scope.web_audit: A Web user with room access retains the room management and audit view; Web downloads re-check the exact room ACL.
scope.rolling_upgrade: Schema 41 migrates incrementally to 42 without rewriting messages, room sequences, sessions, connectors, deliveries, or receipts. Snapshot and restore rehearsal include every SQLite-referenced blob.

covered_boundaries: history, search, wait, native channel, task-input, export, and forward behavior
Web multipart validation and room ACL
Agent download re-authentication, hash verification, atomic save, and redirect rejection
attachment-aware snapshot verification and restore rehearsal
real browser file selection, local image preview, no-target block, @all send, link card, and restricted rendering
Codex, Claude resident, Claude native Channel, task worker, and native TUI attachment contracts
